nodes.name: ZIF-67 coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: 58 mg of cobalt(II) nitrate hexahydrate and 1 mg of cetrimonium bromide were dissolved into 2 mL of deionized (DI) water to prepare solution A. Simultaneously, solution B was prepared by dissolution of 908 mg of 2-methylimidazole into 14 ml of DI water. Solution A was rapidly poured into solution B, and the resulting mixture was then stirred at room temperature (25 °C) for 30 min. The purple precipitate was collected by centrifugation, washed with ethanol at least three times, and homogeneously redispersed into 15 ml of ethanol.

nodes.name: Hierarchical ZIF-67 anion exchange
nodes.procedure: 30 mg of potassium hexacyanocobaltate(III) was dissolved in 5 mL of DI water to obtain solution C. This solution was injected into the ZIF-67 dispersion, followed by magnetic stirring at room temperature (25 °C) for 1 h. Finally, hierarchical ZIF-67 products were obtained through centrifugation, washed with DI water/ethanol several times, and dried at 70 °C overnight.

nodes.procedure: 20 mg of the as-prepared hierarchical ZIF-67 precursors and 100 mg of selenium powder were separately placed at the downstream and upstream positions of a tube furnace in a porcelain boat. The samples were then annealed at 350 °C for 2 h with a heating rate of 2 °C/min under an Ar atmosphere.

nodes.name: S-substituted ZIF-67 hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: 40 mg of the as-prepared hierarchical ZIF-67 precursors and 60 mg of thioacetamide were dispersed in 15 mL of ethanol via ultrasonication. Then, the mixed suspension was transferred into a Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave (20 mL) and kept at 120 °C for 4 h. The obtained S-substituted precipitates were collected by centrifugation, washed several times with DI water and ethanol, and dried at 70 °C overnight.

nodes.procedure: A total of 20 mg of the as-prepared S-substituted precursors and 80 mg of selenium powder were separately placed at the downstream and upstream positions of a tube furnace in a porcelain boat. The samples were then annealed at 400 °C for 2 h with a heating rate of 3 °C/min under Ar atmosphere. The product synthesized with 40 mg of selenium powder was denoted as c-S-CoSe2 (1:1).

nodes.name: o-P-CoSe2 phosphor-selenylation
nodes.procedure: 20 mg of the as-prepared hierarchical ZIF-67 precursor was placed at the downstream position of a tube furnace in a porcelain boat, and 100 mg of sodium hypophosphite and 50 mg of selenium were placed at the upstream position of the tube furnace in a porcelain boat. The samples were then annealed at 400 °C for 2 h with a heating rate of 3 °C/min under an Ar atmosphere.
